test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following two successive discounts are equivalent to a single discount of 84%?
solution:
Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

1. 40% and 60% 

X = 40%, Y = 60%

⇒ 40 + 60 - 2400/100 = 76%

2. 10% and 90%

X = 10%, Y = 90%

⇒ 10 + 90 - 900/100 = 91%

3. 30% and 70%

X = 30%, Y = 70%

⇒ 30 + 70 - 2100/100 = 79%

4. 20% and 80%

X = 20%, Y = 80%

⇒ 20 + 80 - 1600/100 = 84%

**The answer is 20% and 80%.**
